title: Cy Twombly: Leaving Paphos Ringed with Waves

description.main: Catalogue of Cy Twombly's 2009 exhibition at Gagosian, Athens, documenting the four paintings of the series.
description.extended:
Published for Cy Twombly's exhibition at Gagosian, Athens, in 2009, this catalogue documents the four paintings of the series Leaving Paphos Ringed with Waves.

The title comes from Guy Davenport's translation of a line by Alkman, the choral lyric poet of the seventh century BCE. Twombly abbreviated the line, which announces a departure from Paphos, the city sacred to Aphrodite. A boat ideograph recurs across the large canvases, painted in vermilion and yellow over a turquoise sea. It stands for passage and exile, voyaging and homecoming, death and imperial decline. Each painting is reproduced as a tipped-in plate. Demosthenes Davvetas and the art historian Mary Jacobus contribute new essays, and Jacobus's text is illustrated with a painting, a drawing, and a photograph by Twombly.

The book is bound in pale cloth with the title stamped in Greek on the front, and its texts are in English and Greek. Graphic Thought Facility, London, designed it, and Shapco Printing, Minneapolis, printed it.

notes: Catalogue of the exhibition at Gagosian, Merlin Street, Athens. Cloth hardcover with four tipped-in plates. Printed by Shapco Printing, Minneapolis.
